LESSON: THANKFULNESS BY THE END OF THE SUB STRAND

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: By the end of the Sub strand, the ● Learners to read the story of Ananias and Sa
Topic 4.2: Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. thank God for their family, friends and teachers and appreciate them all the time teachers?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. thank God for their family, friends and teachers and appreciate them all the time teachers?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to thank God for their family, friends and teachers and appreciate them all the time teachers?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand.
2. Explain Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand.
4. Show that you can: thank God for their family, friends and teachers and appreciate them all the time teachers?
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. thank God for their family, friends and teachers and appreciate them all the time teachers?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
